PUBLISHING - not an open blocker any more, RETAINED AS DURABLE GUIDANCE because the cause is unchanged and will recur on any unattached cloud/Cowork run. The 09/09/26 build did reach the repo and is live (see provenance). What follows is the diagnosis of why the RUN ITSELF could not push, established 09/09/26, and it is NOT what the 04/09 state said. A credential-injecting GIT PROXY sits in front of both github.com (git) and api.github.com (API), inside the CONNECT tunnel (TLS is re-terminated at the agent proxy, whose CA the session trusts). It DISCARDS any credential you supply and injects its own: a Claude Code GitHub App user-to-server token authenticated AS ollieleuthart (proved - api.github.com/user returns his account id 295091854, X-Oauth-Client-Id Iv23liqTIFEtdIu6Vn1r, 15000/hr). It then serves that credential ONLY for repos in 'this session's authorized repository set'. THAT SET IS EMPTY - anthropics/claude-code, octocat/Hello-World and torvalds/linux all 403 with the identical message, so ssa-tracker is not specifically excluded; NOTHING is attached. The git path says it outright: 'access denied by the git proxy: ollieleuthart/ssa-tracker is not in this session's authorized repository set, so the proxy will not inject a credential for it. To fix, add the repository to the session's sources.' CONSEQUENCES FOR FUTURE RUNS: (1) NEVER ask Ollie for a PAT - the proxy discards it, it cannot even be tested here, and the injected identity is already his. (2) 'Retry in a fresh session' only helps if that session has the repo ATTACHED AS A SOURCE at creation; a fresh session with nothing attached fails identically. (3) It is not an egress-policy block - the agent proxy's recentRelayFailures shows ZERO github entries (only google hosts from the Playwright run), the CONNECT succeeds, and the 403 body carries no Server or X-GitHub-Request-Id header, unlike the genuine 200 from /user. WHY IT STARTED: pushing worked continuously from 19/06/26 to 01/09/26 13:33 AEST (commit 3cec7b2, the current HEAD, which is byte-identical to the deployed index.html). Every commit in the repo's history is authored AND committed as 'ssa <ollie@smart-switchappliances.com>' in near-simultaneous pairs one second apart - the signature of the Contents API method with an explicit committer, using Ollie's own PAT. That is NOT the GitHub App identity, so before 01/09 api.github.com was an ordinary host and his PAT reached GitHub. The proxy interception appeared between 01/09 and 04/09. Nothing about the repo, the token or the tracker changed - the session type did. TWO CORRECTIONS ADDED 09/09/26 POST-RUN: (a) the line above calling commit 3cec7b2 'the current HEAD, byte-identical to the deployed index.html' was true at pull 28/08 and is now STALE - HEAD has moved and the deployed build is pull 09/09/26. (b) A SECOND, DIFFERENT failure mode exists and must not be confused with this one: a LOCAL DESKTOP session (Windows, this machine) has no git, no python and no node installed at all, so it cannot clone, compute, build the xlsx or push, and the proxy diagnosis above is untested and irrelevant there. Distinguish them by the symptom - proxy = a 403 with an 'authorized repository set' message; local desktop = 'git' is not recognised as a command. In the local case the fix is not attaching a repo, it is running from a repo-scoped cloud session, or hand-delivering the built files for manual upload.
